title: Scale Solo #09 (butterfly)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 30s goddess, curvy petite physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — smallest most compact frame possible yet curves exploding at absolute maximum in every direction, bubble butt projecting dramatically backward from the tiny frame, thighs so thick they dwarf the petite frame, blunt collarbone-length bob thick heavy — her own skin itself covered in thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not fabric, not a garment, not a printed pattern, this is the real cellular structure of her own skin, each scale casting its own small shadow on the scales beneath it, nothing lying flat as one smooth sheet. Dense overlapping fields — BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations shifting across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail filling every remaining gap with real texture, every scale catching the light with a sharp shifting glint as the angle changes, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead — most extreme curvy petite silhouette ever displayed.
extreme platform heels covered in the same scale texture, the shimmer continuing unbroken onto the shoe, extra long stiletto nails with the same iridescent shimmer at each tip.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every individual scale and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
